end program lantern

# A synthetic measurement notebook

For the samples $x_1=2$, $x_2=4$ and $x_3=6$, the mean is $\bar{x}=4$.

$$
\bar{x}=\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}x_i
$$

A compact matrix:

$$
A=\begin{bmatrix}1 & 2\\3 & 4\end{bmatrix},\qquad \det(A)=1\cdot4-2\cdot3=-2
$$

The familiar identity $a^2+b^2=c^2$ stays inline. A display integral remains separate:

$$
\int_0^1 x^2\,dx=\frac{1}{3}
$$

```latex

```
